title: MCP Server
description: Connect AI agents to this project over the Model Context Protocol using OAuth or a personal API key.
ownerOnly: Only a project owner can turn MCP access on or off.
keyHint: Create a personal key on the API keys page, then replace {apiKey} in the snippet.

notes.claudeDesktop: Claude Desktop reaches remote servers through the mcp-remote bridge. Needs Node.js.
notes.other: Any client that supports MCP over Streamable HTTP works. Point it at the endpoint and send an Authorization: Bearer {apiKey} header.

oauth.title: Connect with OAuth
oauth.description: Use this option for any MCP client that supports OAuth, including ChatGPT and Claude. You sign in with your Itsaplan account; no personal API key is shared with the client.

steps.add: Add an MCP app in your client and paste the MCP endpoint.
steps.choose: Choose OAuth when the client asks for authentication.
steps.signIn: Sign in to Itsaplan and approve the requested access.

oauth.security: OAuth uses PKCE (S256), dynamic client registration, and bearer tokens scoped to your Itsaplan account.

consent.title: Authorize Itsaplan
consent.description: Allow this MCP client to act with the permissions of your Itsaplan account.
consent.missingCode: This authorization request is missing its consent code.
